data.body:
[P2] Bound file-envelope encoding before materializing it

`encodeEnvelope` builds the complete file-reference JSON before checking its configured limit. A custom preview can reference a very large existing value, causing an unbounded duplicate string allocation and potentially exhausting heap instead of returning the intended size error. Serialize once into a capped collecting sink, reject immediately after `limit + 1` bytes, and reuse the collected encoding when it fits. Add constrained-heap coverage for an oversized custom preview.
